answer: Each account must answer a timed ping from several randomly chosen verifier nodes scattered across an ocean of regions. The round-trip signal timings become a path fingerprint. Identities whose fingerprints collapse onto the same network bridge—same last-mile ASN or VPS rack—share a single reward. A farm hosted in one datacenter looks like one seat, so an attacker who wants N full payouts must buy and keep N geographically distinct residential or dedicated links.
